# LeastPass

> Tactile, zero-telemetry, client-side cryptographic password generator and information entropy security suite developed by Neeraj Rekwar.

## Overview

LeastPass (https://leastpass.vercel.app or https://ais-pre-oadcti4whd6ltse56q3rhf-291116410510.asia-southeast1.run.app) is an open-source, privacy-first web application designed to generate cryptographically uncrackable passwords, memorable multi-word passphrases, and numeric PINs directly inside browser memory without sending data to any server.

Built with a distinctive modern Claymorphic UI system, it features real-time Shannon information entropy telemetry, brute-force crack-time benchmarking, and an interactive cryptography lab.

## Key Facts

- **Developer**: Neeraj Rekwar (Full-Stack Web & Interface Developer)
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/devneeraj77
- **Creator Support / Buy Me a Coffee**: https://ko-fi.com/neerajrekwar2001
- **Email**: dev.neerajrekwar@gmail.com
- **License**: MIT Open Source
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Web Cryptography API (`crypto.getRandomValues`)
- **Privacy Model**: 100% Client-side. Zero server API calls, zero analytics cookies, zero database persistence, zero telemetry.

## Core Capabilities

1. **Cryptographic Random String Generator**:
   - Hardware-backed CSPRNG using `window.crypto.getRandomValues()` instead of pseudo-random `Math.random()`.
   - Length configuration from 6 to 64 characters.
   - Character sets: Uppercase (A-Z), Lowercase (a-z), Digits (0-9), Special Symbols (!@#$%^&*).
   - Ambiguous character filtering to remove confusing glyphs (0, O, 1, l, I, |).

2. **Memorable Diceware Passphrase Generator**:
   - Multi-word diceware-inspired passphrases using curated non-confusable word pools.
   - Custom separators (hyphens, dots, underscores, spaces).
   - Title-case capitalization and random numeric injection for high-entropy compliance.

3. **Secure Numeric PIN Generator**:
   - 4- to 12-digit numeric PINs for banking, two-factor auth, and hardware security keys.

4. **Information Entropy & GPU Crack-Time Benchmarking**:
   - Formula: E = L * log2(N) where L is length and N is pool cardinality.
   - Crack time estimates against distributed GPU clusters (100 billion guesses/second).

5. **Local Ephemeral Session History**:
   - In-memory recent password history (up to 5 items) during the active browser session with instant copy and purge actions.

## Main Pages & Resources

- `/`: Main interactive generator workstation, entropy meter, security lab, and developer spotlight.
- `/about`: The philosophy of LeastPass, developer biography for Neeraj Rekwar, zero-telemetry architecture, and technical principles.

- `/blog`: Password security articles, mathematical entropy breakdowns, and diceware guides (configured for headless CMS / Sanity integration).
- `/sitemap.xml`: XML sitemap indexing all application pages and articles.
- `/robots.txt`: Search crawler directives allowing full indexing.
